evidence.requirementId: Runnable Vite React+TS app in D:\npqo with a dark pixel-terminal visual language inspired by the reference image (not copied literally).
evidence.summary: Vite 7 + React 19 + TypeScript app builds successfully. README documents setup and the self-hosted fonts/SVG design. A real Chrome run rendered the full dashboard at 1440/1024/390, and the saved screenshots show the dark pink/mint pixel-terminal styling.

evidence.requirementId: Exactly 8 agent cards (CHIEF, SCAN, VET, SOCIAL, SIZE, FILLS, RISK, CRAWLER) whose metrics update from the live event stream, with pause/resume control.
evidence.summary: The engine exposes exactly the eight AGENT_IDS and the provider updates cards from one snapshot interval. Vitest asserts 8 unique cards with the required names and verifies PAUSE holds the tick, STEP advances exactly once and RESUME restarts. The Chrome run found 8 cards at all three widths and verified held tick 1 -> stepped 2 -> resumed 3.

evidence.requirementId: Dynamic financial charts: live equity area chart with hover tooltip, candlestick/volume chart, card sparklines and tickers fed by the same stream.
evidence.summary: EquityPanel draws the stream balance series as an SVG area/line with volume bars, endpoint pulse and a clamped hover tooltip. CandleChart renders 30 OHLC candles, MA(7) and volumes; card sparklines read agent series. Vitest verifies the equity path and card value change after one tick, and the browser hover produced 'DAY 11 / TICK 0-27 $71,914.80'.

evidence.requirementId: Central pixel-art room with multiple workstations, agents, monitors, vault/server decor, animated cables, scanlines and event-reactive labels.
evidence.summary: PixelRoom.tsx implements a hand-drawn 1200x600 SVG with six agent workstations, live candle wall, bank cage, vault, risk rack, printer, plants, fan, avatars, speech bubbles and animated cables/scanlines. Focused-agent labels and station pings are driven by snapshot.activeAgent. Chrome measured the room at 1372x686 (1440), 975x455 (1024) and 368x300 (390) and found 6 stations.

evidence.requirementId: A single deterministic simulated event source (seeded engine + provider) consumed by all sections, with no per-component fake timers.
evidence.summary: MarketEngine.ts uses mulberry32 and one warmup/tick pipeline for price, candles, balance, order book, thresholds, activity and all agents. AgentStreamProvider owns the sole window.setInterval and exposes pause/step. Tests prove identical snapshots for the same seed across eight ticks and verify a single interval changes cards, charts and room together.

evidence.requirementId: Responsive layouts at 1440px, 1024px and 390px without horizontal overflow, verified in a real browser.
evidence.summary: Real headless Chrome rendered 1440x1000, 1024x900 and 390x844. The agent grid resolved to 4/2/1 columns; document scrollWidth equaled clientWidth (1440/1024/390), there were no overflowing layout elements, and the room remained visible at 1372x686, 975x455 and 368x300.

evidence.requirementId: Automated tests (engine determinism, stream/provider, 8 cards, pause, charts, room) and saved screenshots at all three widths.
evidence.summary: Two Vitest files with nine tests pass locally and in the broader integration run. The browser suite passes pause/step/resume and hover checks. Five PNG deliverables plus verification.json are saved: 1440, 1024 and 390 full pages, a pixel-room close-up, and the equity hover state.
